properties.title: The Willow Residence
properties.subtitle: 12 Willow Lane. Family of four. Recently decreased to three.
properties.briefing: Standard residential relocation. Family has already vacated. Do not discuss the family with the family.
notes: CUSTOMER REQUESTS: nothing that 'looks at them' is to be loaded.
NOTE FROM DISPATCH: the previous crew quit at 03:40. Their van is still in the driveway. Ignore the van.
REMINDER: the garage door does not open. Do not attempt to open the garage door.

properties.title: The Endless House
properties.subtitle: No fixed address. No fixed floor plan.
properties.briefing: The house has more rooms than the deed allows. Map accordingly. Do not trust the map.
notes: PRIOR CREW REPORT: 'the corridor was on the left'. Corridor is not on the left.
NOTE FROM DISPATCH: if a door leads to the room you just left, it is still the same door.
DO NOT prop doors open. The house takes this personally.

properties.title: The Dollhouse
properties.subtitle: Ashgrove Manor. Collection of 411 dolls. 412 at last count.
properties.briefing: Contents include a porcelain collection of significant value. The collection is insured. You are not.
notes: CUSTOMER REQUESTS: keep the parlour dolls facing the window.
NOTE FROM DISPATCH: if a doll is warm, log it on form 12-B.
REMINDER: do not count the dolls out loud.

properties.title: The Sinking House
properties.subtitle: 14 Harbour Row. Water level: rising. Insurance: expired.
properties.briefing: Coastal property, partial flooding. The tide is not expected. The water is not tidal.
notes: PRIOR CREW REPORT: 'we lost the fridge to the hallway'.
NOTE FROM DISPATCH: electrical hazards are considered an employee responsibility.
REMINDER: floating furniture is still contracted furniture.

properties.title: The Perfect Home
properties.subtitle: One occupant. No occupant. Please clarify at reception.
properties.briefing: A premium property. Presentation is part of the contract. Scratches, smudges and disorder will be invoiced.
notes: CUSTOMER REQUESTS: do not drag anything. Do not lean on anything. Do not breathe on the wallpaper.
NOTE FROM DISPATCH: the house has an opinion about arrangement.
REMINDER: if the room corrects itself, do not correct it back.

properties.title: The Abandoned Hotel
properties.subtitle: The Grand Meridian. Closed 1974. Still checking guests in.
properties.briefing: Six floors, one working elevator, no working elevator. Retrieve contracted items from floors 1 through 3.
notes: PRIOR CREW REPORT: 'room 214 is room 214. room 214 is also room 412'.
NOTE FROM DISPATCH: guests are not to be disturbed. Guests are not on the inventory.
REMINDER: bell carts are company property, not a ride.

properties.title: The House That Breathes
properties.subtitle: Structural classification: biological. Please do not feed the property.
properties.briefing: Interior surfaces are not load-bearing in the conventional sense. Noise is discouraged. Movement is discouraged. The contract is not.
notes: PRIOR CREW REPORT: 'the walls moved'. Walls corroborate.
NOTE FROM DISPATCH: do not remove anything that appears to be an organ.
REMINDER: if the floor inhales, wait. If the floor exhales, leave.

properties.title: The Last Customer
properties.subtitle: Address withheld. Customer has been waiting a long time.
properties.briefing: Final contract before quarterly review. Recover the crate. Recover everything else if convenient. Do not open the crate.
notes: CUSTOMER REQUESTS: the crate. That is the whole request.
NOTE FROM DISPATCH: this address has been in our files since before the company existed.
REMINDER: you were not told to open the crate.
